limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter but also made `ready_a` high during reset and allowed a bit to be accepted on the first clock after reset, when the original registered `ready_a` was still low.
Gating `valid_b` with `valid_a` suppressed the original assertion during idle cycles with the counter at five, changing output timing beyond the counter fix.
The passing test required `ready_a` to be high in reset and expected `valid_b` to be low during gaps after five accepted bits, so it endorsed both unintended changes instead of catching them.
